top_10_systemic_issues.issue: Relics collection uses completely custom schema (era_letter, total_relics, drop_systems, notable_relics, refinement_costs) instead of the required Zod schema fields (era, drops, refinement, slug). All 5 relic files fail schema validation.

Arcane effects fabricated: arcane-crepuscular describes a completely different arcane (health-threshold damage reduction instead of Ability Strength while invisible). At least 3/8 sampled arcanes (38%) have wrong effect descriptions vs WFCD.
top_10_systemic_issues.estimated_files_affected: 3-4/8 sampled; extrapolates to ~40-50% of 179 total arcane files

top_10_systemic_issues.issue: Mod effect fields describe wrong mechanics: hammer-shot says accuracy+knockdown but WFCD says critDamage+statusChance; irradiating-disarm uses 'Augment enhancement' instead of real Radiation proc description. Pattern suggests many mod effects were invented.
top_10_systemic_issues.estimated_files_affected: ~30-40% of 229 total mod files based on sample

top_10_systemic_issues.issue: masteryRank=0 universally across all warframe files (confirmed on all 6 sampled). This is the documented WFCD exception (issue #23) but the fix requires sourcing Fandom Wiki per DATA.md. None of the sampled files show evidence of the Fandom override being applied.

Resource files use vague/fabricated drop locations: planets='Multiple locations', dropSources='Mission rewards','Enemy drops' rather than specific nodes. 6/10 sampled resources have this problem. Some make false factual claims (training-debt-bond says non-tradeable when Debt Bonds are tradeable).

Word count failures are widespread in weapons: 9/15 sampled weapons either fail the 500-word floor or barely pass. sancti-castanas has zero body content. Weapons appear to be a mix of high-quality and stub files.
top_10_systemic_issues.estimated_files_affected: ~50-60% of 589 weapon files estimated to be under-floor

top_10_systemic_issues.issue: Generic template content leaked into final files: phrases like 'This weapon combines effective damage output with unique handling characteristics', 'many variants or upgraded versions may exist', 'depends heavily on proper modding' appear verbatim in multiple weapon files. Likely from a template that was never properly filled.

H2 section ordering violations: mods use 'stat table' or 'usage' instead of the required 'stats per rank' and 'builds that use it'; missions use non-standard headers; arcanes use 'effects per rank' or 'best on'. The verifier's section-order check would fail ~30-40% of files.

Em-dash characters (U+2014) present in body text of multiple files violating STYLE.md ASCII-only requirement. Found in weapons/corinth-prime, weapons/kuva-kohm, weapons/dual-cestra, weapons/heliocor, resources/adramal-alloy, resources/training-debt-bond.

Weapon stat errors: dual-cestra has criticalMultiplier=0.0 and criticalChance=0.00 (both wrong per WFCD); kuva-kohm has masteryRank=0 vs WFCD masteryReq=13 and is missing magazine field. Critical stat accuracy cannot be trusted without full WFCD re-verification pass.
top_10_systemic_issues.estimated_files_affected: Unknown; at least 2/15 sampled weapons have wrong numeric stats

quality_leaders.quality_pattern: Quests and warframes are the highest-quality collections. Quest files show evidence of careful authorship with proper spoiler handling, WFCD citations, and narrative depth. Warframe files have correct stats but universally fail masteryRank (systematic WFCD gap). Relics, weapons, and arcanes are the weakest collections.

estimated_effort_to_ship_quality.relics_collection: Complete rewrite of all 5 relic files to use the Zod schema (era, drops, refinement, slug fields). The current files are good reference content trapped in wrong schema. ~4-6 hours.
estimated_effort_to_ship_quality.arcanes_effect_audit: Full WFCD cross-check of all 179 arcane effect fields. At least 3 confirmed wrong, likely 20-40% have issues. Manual review + correction pass: ~8-12 hours.
estimated_effort_to_ship_quality.weapons_word_count_stubs: Re-run content pass on ~280-350 weapons estimated below 500-word floor. The stub files need complete body rewrites, not just padding: ~20-30 hours.
estimated_effort_to_ship_quality.weapons_stat_accuracy: Run automated WFCD diff on all 589 weapon files for masteryRank, magazine, critMult, critChance. Fix mismatches: ~4-6 hours (mostly automated).
estimated_effort_to_ship_quality.mods_effect_accuracy: WFCD cross-check of effect fields for all 229 mods. Likely ~30% have wrong or generic effects: ~10-15 hours.
estimated_effort_to_ship_quality.resources_drop_locations: Re-source specific drop locations for ~130-150 resource files with vague/fabricated planets/dropSources fields: ~8-12 hours.
estimated_effort_to_ship_quality.masteryRank_warframes: Apply Fandom Wiki lookup for all 110 warframe files per DATA.md exception rule: ~2-3 hours (automated with wiki API).
estimated_effort_to_ship_quality.ascii_cleanup: Automated sed replacement of em-dash with -- across all files: ~0.5 hours.
estimated_effort_to_ship_quality.total_estimate: 50-85 developer-hours to reach ship quality across all collections. Relics and arcanes are blocking (schema violations = CI failures). Weapons are the largest volume effort. Quests and syndicates are already close to ship quality.
